speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by determining the timeline and severity of your symptoms. How long have you been experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss? Also, have you noticed any fevers, night sweats, or changes in your appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the significant weight loss and constitutional symptoms, have you noticed any night sweats, persistent fevers, or lymph node swelling? REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP, ESR/CRP; REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 36.7°C (98.0°F), Blood Pressure 126/74 mmHg, Heart Rate 87 bpm, Respiratory Rate 17 breaths/min. Examination: General appearance consistent with chronic illness; bilateral cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy palpable; splenomegaly present on abdominal exam. Complete Blood Count: WBC elevated with lymphocytosis; Hemoglobin normal to slightly decreased; Platelets normal to decreased. Flow Cytometry: Presence of monoclonal B lymphocytes with a phenotype consistent with CLL/SLL.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL).

The combination of significant constitutional symptoms, lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, and flow cytometry confirming monoclonal B cells is diagnostic. Do you have any history of recurrent infections or bleeding tendencies?
